name: [Sans rework]Unknown Battle Simulator
desc:
Unknown Battle Simulator (UBS) is a FFA undertale combat game.

Rules: 

1. Exploiting isnt allowed, if you exploit you will be banned (permanently).

2. If you are toxic it will result in a 1 day ban.

3. Don't bug abuse Breaking this role will result in a 1 day ban, breaking this rule again will result in a 3 day ban

4 Don't farm kills/gold with a friend or alt (breaking this role will get you banned for 1 day)

5 Follow the rules of roblox TOS

--This game has not been disscontinued, and will keep getting updates for now.--
